messages.author: a5ca085497920157
messages.subject: protobuf version change
parts:
Fresh install from this file https://github.com/saptarshiguha/RHIPE/blob/master/code/Rhipe_0.73.1.tar.gz

Result:
rounds@ubuntu:~/workspace/rhipe/code$ sudo R CMD INSTALL Rhipe*
* installing to library ‘/usr/local/lib/R/site-library’
* installing *source* package ‘Rhipe’ ...
** libs
g++ -I/usr/share/R/include -DNDEBUG      -fpic  -O2 -pipe -g  -I.  -O2 -pipe -g  -DUSEAUTOSHORT -DHAVE_UINTPTR_T    `/usr/lib/R/bin/R CMD config --cppflags` `pkg-config --cflags protobuf` -c rexp.pb.cc -o rexp.pb.o
In file included from rexp.pb.cc:4:0:
rexp.pb.h:17:2: error: #error This file was generated by an older version of protoc which is
rexp.pb.h:18:2: error: #error incompatible with your Protocol Buffer headers. Please
rexp.pb.h:19:2: error: #error regenerate this file with a newer version of protoc.
make: *** [rexp.pb.o] Error 1
ERROR: compilation failed for package ‘Rhipe’
* removing ‘/usr/local/lib/R/site-library/Rhipe’


First solution attempt ran into a problem.

### ATTEMPT REBUILD FROM code/R/src/rexp.proto ###


jrounds@ubuntu:~/workspace/rhipe/code/R/src$ protoc --version
libprotoc 2.5.0
jrounds@ubuntu:~/workspace/rhipe/code/R/src$ protoc rexp.proto --cpp_out=.
rexp.proto:34:3: Expected "required", "optional", or "repeated".
rexp.proto:35:3: Expected "required", "optional", or "repeated".
rexp.proto:36:3: Expected "required", "optional", or "repeated".

Problem lines are these https://github.com/saptarshiguha/RHIPE/blob/master/code/R/src/rexp.proto#L34


They don't exist in a previous version of the file:
https://github.com/saptarshiguha/RHIPE/blob/834ca043e2509a0949677589f03928e740526313/code/R/src/rexp.proto




Decision needs to made: revert to older version or decorate new lines with required, optional, repeated.

messages.author: a5ca085497920157
messages.subject: Re: protobuf version change
parts:
I just put optional in front of lines 34, 35, and 36 in rexp.proto

That gets through a rebuild with  protoc  version 2.5 and allows the package to be compiled and installed in R 3.0.0 .  No test yet though and I am kind of concerned about rexp.proto changes, so we will see!



I am expecting R 3.0.0 to fail.  I am hunting for the problem.  This is just about getting rexp.proto to rebuild.
